---
title: Rich computed tables
engine: knitr
---

## Grouped results {#results}

::: {#grouped-table}
```{r}
#| label: grouped-maker
#| echo: false
values <- read.csv("data.csv", check.names=FALSE)
gt::gt(values) |>
  gt::tab_header(title=gt::md("**Grouped results**"), subtitle="Measured offline") |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label="Statistics", columns=c(N, Mean)) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns=Mean, decimals=2) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(footnote="Observed values", locations=gt::cells_column_labels(columns=N)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note="Source: local input")
```
:::

## Summary by arm {#summary}

::: {#summary-table}
```{r}
#| label: summary-maker
#| echo: false
participants <- read.csv("participants.csv", na.strings="NA")
gtsummary::tbl_summary(participants, by=arm, missing="ifany") |>
  gtsummary::bold_labels()
```
:::
